01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioners have filed this writ petition challenging the order dated 29.10.2024 passed by the Special Land Acquisition officers (NH), Land Acquisition Cell No. 20, Jajpur, opposite party no.5 under Annexure- 5 with a further prayer to direct the opposite parties to release the compensation amount in their favour in respect of the acquired land measuring Ac. 0.13 decimals along with the constriction value as the Deity 'Sri Saptagosain' is not a public deity.

Averments have been taken in the writ petition that the petitioners acquired the property in question by way of Marfatdars of the private deity along with other co- sharers and the opposite party nos.2 and 3 notified the land of the deity for acquisition and prepared compensation roll by mentioning the name of the awarded tenant in which the names of the petitioners are not mentioned.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are the Marfatdars of the deity 'Sri Saflagosain' of Chandpur and they challenged the wrong recording of the R.O.R. published in the name of the persons, who are not the Marfatdars of the deity before the learned Civil Judge (Senior Dhirendra Kumar vs State Of Odisha And ..... Opp. Parties on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68700362/
1 Divison), Jajpur in Civil Suit No. 296 of 2024, which is still subjudice.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioners earlier approached this Court in W.P.(C) No. 18870 of 2024, which was disposed of on 27.08.2024 with a direction to the opposite party no.3 to consider the representation of the petitioners and accordingly, the opposite party no.3 vide impugned order dated 29.10.2024 disposed of the representation wherein after nothing down the factual aspects and going through the written note of argument, observed as follows :
" On the face of the R.O.R., the Deity Sri Sapta Gosain is a public deity.

In view of the instruction communicated by Govt. wherein it has been instructed to deposit the compensation amount awarded in respect of any Deity's property with the Commissioner of Endowment, Odisha, Bhubaneswar for disposal at his level, the Commissioner of Endowment, Odisha, Bhubaneswar has been requested vide Letter No. 242 dt. 11.08.2023 to issue necessary instruction as to whether the compensation amount belonging to the deities shall be paid to the Marfatdar or to the Commissioner of Endowment, Odisha.

In response to the above letter, Commissioner of Endowment, Odisha has intimated the account details to deposit the said amount with a direction to the Inspector of Endowment to sign the voucher with his official Seal.
The above amount has not been transferred so far due to non-turning up the Inspector of Endowment, Jajpur till date.
In view of the facts discussed above, this Court lacks jurisdiction to consider the prayer of the petitioner.
The petitioner is free to agitate his claim in proper Court of Law."

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in view of the provisions available under the Odisha Hindu Religious Endowment Act, 1951, the property in question can be declared as a private deity by the Assistant Commissioner of Endowment and therefore, the petitioners may be permitted to approach the appropriate authority in accordance with law.
Considering such submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties and on perusing the impugned order, we find no illegality or impropriety in the same.
However, the petitioners are at liberty to approach the appropriate authority by filing necessary application under the Odisha Hindu Religious Endowment Act, 1951.

If such an application is made within a period of four weeks from today, the concerned authority shall dispose of the same expeditiously after giving opportunity of hearing to all the parties concerned.
It is made clear that we have not expressed any opinion on the merits of the application to be filed by the petitioners.
With the aforesaid observation and direction, the writ petition stands disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy.

( S.K. Sahoo)
